title: Data of the event run.finished.v1
description: The end of work that continues outside the farm after a task result of accepted for run (a pipeline, a backup outside manifests). A job worker submits it through P1 emit when the type is in the events of its task type; the fields are closed, the subject is from the catalog of its own tenant, and the core sets source and id (OBV-7, IDM-4).

run_id.description: Id of the work outside the farm.

approval_id.description: The approval that started the run; by it a route finds the address approval_initiator (DLV-6).

subject.description: Id of a resource or host from the catalog of the worker's tenant.

duration_s.description: Duration of the work in seconds.
